observations.observation: Near-touchline midpoint has the largest residual, 12.9737 source pixels. The actual touchline deviates from the straight corner polygon.
observations.hypothesis: Panoramic warp, manual corner selection and line thickness contribute. Sparse controls cannot isolate the cause.
observations.consequence: A narrow near-boundary strip can be rejected; no positions are clipped onto the boundary.
observations.next_check: Human review of corner/control points and additional line points; do not tune on held-out groups.

observations.observation: High-confidence near-touchline persons have ground points outside the field and remain visible on video without map points.
observations.next_check: Confirm their role visually. Do not call these false positives just because they are not players.

observations.observation: Far-edge person has confidence 0.340 and box bottom y=193.889; field polygon rejects it.
observations.hypothesis: Actual position, box-foot uncertainty and corner error all affect boundary classification.
observations.next_check: Review the native-resolution far-touchline crop before classifying the detection or projection as wrong.

observations.observation: Some small visible field persons are not shown at display threshold 0.25; no reviewed bounding-box references exist.
observations.hypothesis: A candidate can be below display threshold or missing from the detector.
observations.next_check: Annotate and review before counting FN, precision, recall or mAP.

observations.observation: Several nearby field persons produce overlapping labels/boxes. No identity continuity is available in this tracking-free pilot.
observations.next_check: Review the footpoint per box and possible duplicate detections; tracking waits for MVP acceptance and player classes.

observations.observation: 24 ball detections at confidence >=0.10 were preserved, all without ground positions.
observations.next_check: Review labels before deciding whether detections correspond to the real ball; no ball-tracking claim.
